alt: 孩子在校園壁畫上為龍補上最後一點眼睛，原本呆板的龍頓時顯得精神生動。
scene_prompt: 畫龍點睛 means a crucial finishing touch that brings a work to life. Modern school art classroom, one older child in casual clothes holds a fine paintbrush and carefully adds the final small dark PUPIL to the eye of a large original hand-painted Chinese dragon mural on an easel. The dragon's beautifully curved face and flowing body look vibrant and expressive now that the one tiny eye detail is being completed. Show the other eye as a faint empty outlined circle to clarify what the key missing detail was, but not a blind or injured living animal. It is unmistakably a PAINTING, dragon does not literally leave the paper. Another child nearby looks delighted by the new lively expression. No existing franchise dragon.
